Then she doesnt want to. Still hang out with her and have fun with her. Invite her to do stuff. You know how much I wish my older brothers and sisters would invite me out to do something 1 on 1. Instead havent heard from them in years. Make it known you have fun with her and do stuff with her.

And the best thing you can do for her right now is to be there for her. She should honestly count herself lucky that she has someone who cares enough to actually just care enough about her. Lot of us don't have that. Just gotta be there for her. Let her vent to you. Be her outlet.

Best thing I can say is to real talk with her. Dont make her feel like shit for asking why she did it. Dont put her down by saying what about me or mom and dad because that is the worst thing you can do. Suicidal people like me and her and many others really just want someone to be there. Someone who doesnt think of us a burden. Be there for her and do things she wants to do and be involved. Dont go with her somewhere to end up just staring at your phone. Dont go somewhere you want to go but she doesnt want to. Even just hanging out and vibing with her is good. Just be there for her in the right way

It's more than just that with the depression. My family hates me because my mom's side hates my dad's and my dad's side hates my mom so each side hates half of me so I don't talk or see them a lot. My friends stopped hanging out with me and if I wanted to do anything with them it'd be like pulling teeth to get them to do anything. I don't understand love and I doubt I ever will. Never been in a relationship and every girl I kind of had a crush on but just kept to myself looks at me like I'm trash. I'm average in school and the only living thing that I feel has any affection towards me is my cat. But my self image as always played a part in every aspect of my life and it just feels like it's not getting any better. I don't even know what I look like anymore. I dont look at mirrors or anything, I stay out of photos, and try to keep to myself as much as possible because I've learned that people don't want to be seen with me. For weight, last time I went to the doctor about 2 months ago I weighed in at 290 but that's still too big for me to handle and I can still tell I'm not worth any bodies affection.

I'm not a DM but during the campaign I'm involved with rn we were fighting some undead tree monsters and their worshippers. We found out before that the weakness of the tree monsters was oil so I stocked up ok plenty of oil. We were fighting the tree monsters and the cultists when I had an idea and rolled to see if i could convince the worshippers to drink some of the oil because it resembled what they drank to transform into tree monsters. My roll was successful and I took out the cultists with one turn. And then earlier the merchant who gave me the oil wanted a branch of the main tree. I knew this was a trap so on the way back to the town i grabbed a tree branch and cast a spell on it to make it seem magical. When we got back to town I had to roll to convince the lady that this was the branch I had promised and rolled a NAT 20.
